description: This file appears to be a shell script that contains test cases for a Git-P4 integration tool, specifically testing user preservation features and permissions handling when submitting changes from Git to Perforce. It includes function definitions, environmental setup, and test scenarios involving user permissions, commit authorship, and change submission behaviors.

methods.name: p4_grant_admin
methods.description: Sets Perforce protections to grant admin rights to specified user.

methods.name: p4_check_commit_author
methods.description: Checks whether the latest Perforce change for a file was made by a specific user.

methods.name: make_change_by_user
methods.description: Creates a change in a local file, adds it to Git, and commits it with a specified author.
